# AdvaCare Pharma

> Global manufacturer and distributor of pharmaceuticals, medical devices, dietary supplements, and veterinary products with ISO, CE, and HACCP certifications.

AdvaCare Pharma operates manufacturing facilities in China, India, and the USA, producing branded product lines including AccuQuik diagnostic tests, AdvaLife supplements, StayGuard medical supplies, and AdvaMate veterinary care products. The company specializes in point-of-care testing devices, rapid diagnostic kits, hospital supplies, and nutritional supplements for global healthcare markets.

## Key Topics

- AccuQuik rapid diagnostic tests
- AdvaLife dietary supplements
- StayGuard medical devices
- Point-of-care testing (POCT)
- ISO 9001, ISO 22000, HACCP certifications
- Hemoglobin testing systems
- Rapid immunology diagnostics
- Hospital supplies and wound care
- Blood testing devices
- Portable medical devices
- Pharmaceutical manufacturing
- Veterinary diagnostics
- CE and ISO certified products
- Global distribution (China, India, USA)

## Rapid Diagnostic Tests & Point-of-Care Testing

- [Hemoglobin Testing System](https://www.advacarepharma.com/en/medical-devices/hemoglobin-testing-system): AccuQuik hemoglobin testing system for blood hemoglobin measurement
- [Malaria Test Kits](https://www.advacarepharma.com/en/medical-devices/malaria-test-kits): AccuQuik rapid diagnostic kits for Plasmodium falciparum/vivax detection
- [Troponin Test Kit (cTnI)](https://www.advacarepharma.com/en/medical-devices/troponin-test-kit-ctnl): AccuQuik rapid cardiac troponin I test for heart damage detection
- [HIV Test Kits](https://www.advacarepharma.com/en/medical-devices/hiv-test-kits): AccuQuik rapid HIV 1+2 antibody & P24 antigen diagnostic test kits
- [(AFP) Alpha-Fetoprotein Test Kit](https://www.advacarepharma.com/en/medical-devices/afp-alpha-fetoprotein-test-kit): AccuQuik AFP rapid test for liver cancer & birth defect diagnosis
- [Hemoglobin Test Strips](https://www.advacarepharma.com/en/medical-devices/hemoglobin-test-strips): AccuQuik test strips for hemoglobin monitoring system blood testing
